cards.p: That $6.39 is the whole budget advertising has to fit inside.
Over 400 clicks it is 10 orders, where the required 14.1% would have produced about 56. That gap is too large to be chance.
Now the same money in two places. Take $4,000 you have not spent yet, and three months.
What that $4,000 earns in the next product is unknown. But it is available, and it is not being spent at a known $29.61 loss per sale.
